title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：tomb　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tomb 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the warden ① visited the tomb that no resident in the centre would have noted, and he said the visiting was the whole of the month. The ② tomb, meaning the grave itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a tomb, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ tomb in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ tomb at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tomb, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the warden said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tomb was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the grave. The ⑥ tomb, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; tomb, he said, is either something you visit or the only word that means both a grave and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ tomb had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ tomb of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of noting; tomb, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tomb I remember is the grave noted in the register, which closed in 1971 and is still noted as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ tomb, my mother said in 1973, is the only grave that improves by being noted; every tomb, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a grave. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 坟墓（指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 坟墓（指那座坟墓本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：visit the tomb 扫这一座坟墓
D. n. 坟墓（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 坟墓之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的坟墓之事）
F. n. 坟墓（指登记册里写到、被记下的那一座）
G. n. 坟墓、追思（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 追思（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: visited the tomb that no resident in the centre would have noted
The tomb, meaning the grave itself and not the notice
the tomb at the far gate

answers.why: visit the tomb 意为“扫这一座坟墓”，1964 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记下的一座坟墓做了一遍。
tomb 意为“坟墓”，指那座坟墓本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
tomb 意为“坟墓”，指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
tomb 意为“坟墓”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tomb 意为“坟墓、追思”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座追思就是那件事的全部。
tomb 意为“追思”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座坟墓，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tomb 意为“坟墓”，指登记册里写到、被记下的那一座，到 1969 年这一座成了登记册里的一行。
tomb 意为“坟墓之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的坟墓之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记下。
tomb 意为“坟墓”，我记得的是登记册里记下过的那一座，1971 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一座。
tomb 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，坟墓是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的坟墓。
